scope: Optional offline reviewed-lyrics alignment through an explicitly pinned PocketSphinx English CPU profile, with immutable authored text/review provenance and probabilistic word/cue timing, conservative partial mapping, source/stem scope, Pipeline v3 lifecycle and loss-aware export.

admitted_profile.version_boundary: This release has no native version command. The release is a caller declaration bound to an executable digest, not independently authenticated.
admitted_profile.source: English, mono 16000 Hz PCM16 RIFF WAV; at most 600 seconds/256 MiB
admitted_profile.acoustic_model: Explicit local en-us seven-file inventory; at most 64 MiB, with exact admitted feat.params and noisedict control text
admitted_profile.dictionary: Explicit pinned local file; at most 16 MiB
admitted_profile.reviewed_lyrics: Explicit reviewed timed-text JSON; at most 64 KiB, 512 ASCII English tokens, 16 KiB normalized phrase
admitted_profile.native_json: One bounded basic PocketSphinx word JSON object; integer 10 ms grid with b=start,d=duration; fillers excluded from word mapping
admitted_profile.native_probability: Native p is checked but never treated as calibrated correctness confidence. Forced grammar cannot prove supplied words occurred.
admitted_profile.default_resource_discovery: Explicit hmm/dict and private nonexistent -lm sentinel suppress compiled default-model probes; native align clears LM before decoder initialization.
